',
      strap:'Elevated Living', bedrooms:'Studio to 4BR', tokenPrice:10, minInvestment:5000, indicativeReturn:8.1, available:62,
      value:35000000, supply:3500000, spv:'One Edition Holdings (Prototype SPV)', status:'Illustrative',
      description:'A contemporary Lahore property shown in the prototype to demonstrate how multiple opportunities can be presented in one digital platform.',
      docs:['Property overview','Illustrative valuation summary','Prototype SPV terms','Risk disclosure','Token terms & transfer rules']
    }
  ];

  const JURISDICTIONS = [
    {id:'PK', name:'Pakistan', status:'Approved', class:'good', access:'Invest + resale (demo)', regulator:'PVARA / SECP / property authorities', api:'KYC/CNIC, AML, banking, FX/remittance'},
    {id:'GB', name:'United Kingdom', status:'Approved', class:'good', access:'Invest + resale (demo)', regulator:'FCA perimeter / ICO data protection', api:'UK identity, AML, payments, data-transfer controls'},
    {id:'AE', name:'UAE / Dubai', status:'Interest only', class:'warn', access:'Browse + register interest', regulator:'Local perimeter review; VARA where applicable', api:'Local KYC, AML, payments, investor classification'},
    {id:'EU', name:'EU / EEA', status:'Interest only', class:'warn', access:'Browse + register interest', regulator:'EU / member-state legal review', api:'EEA KYC, AML, payments, GDPR controls'},
    {id:'GCC', name:'Saudi Arabia / GCC', status:'Interest only', class:'warn', access:'Browse + register interest', regulator:'Country-specific securities / VA / AML review', api:'Local KYC, AML, payment, marketing controls'},
    {id:'NA', name:'USA / Canada', status:'Restricted', class:'danger', access:'Investment disabled by default', regulator:'Dedicated securities, tax and marketing review', api:'KYC, investor classification, tax/reporting, geo controls'}
  ];

  const defaultState = () => ({
    role:'buyer', demoMode:'verified', kycStatus:'Approved', jurisdiction:'GB', investStep:1, selectedProperty:'one-canal', investAmount:25000,
    termsAccepted:false, paymentMethod:'Bank transfer', paymentStatus:'Not started', issued:false,
    seller:{status:'Not registered',step:1,kybStatus:'Not started',docsReady:false,applicationId:null,profile:{sellerType:'Property owner',company:'',name:'Demo Property Owner',email:'owner@example.com',mobile:'+92 300 0000000',jurisdiction:'PK'},property:{name:'Canal View Residence',city:'Lahore',type:'Residential',address:'Canal Road, Lahore',estimatedValue:1200000,titleStatus:'Owner-held title',targetPercent:40,incomeModel:'Rental income + disposal proceeds'}},
    supportCases:[], notifications:[{date:'17 Sep 2026',title:'Portfolio statement ready',body:'Your September prototype statement is available in the investor vault.'},{date:'12 Sep 2026',title:'Marketplace window announced',body:'The next closed resale matching window is scheduled for 30 Sep 2026.'}],
    holdings:[{propertyId:'one-canal', units:2500, avgPrice:10, currentPrice:10.84, income:1425, cert:'OH-2026-00845', certVersion:2, status:'Active'}],
    sellOrders:[], buyOrders:[
      {id:'B-310', propertyId:'one-canal', units:400, price:10.60, created:'11 Sep 2026 09:40', status:'Open'},
      {id:'B-311', propertyId:'one-canal', units:600, price:10.50, created:'12 Sep 2026 14:12', status:'Open'},
      {id:'B-312', propertyId:'one-canal', units:900, price:10.25, created:'14 Sep 2026 18:05', status:'Open'}
    ],
    marketAsks:[
      {id:'S-201', propertyId:'one-canal', units:250, price:10.45, created:'09 Sep 2026 10:15', status:'Open'},
      {id:'S-202', propertyId:'one-canal', units:800, price:10.75, created:'13 Sep 2026 08:25', status:'Open'}
    ],
    settlements:[], certificateHistory:[
      {id:'OH-2026-00691', propertyId:'one-canal', units:2600, version:1, status:'Superseded', issued:'03 Jun 2026'},
      {id:'OH-2026-00845', propertyId:'one-canal', units:2500, version:2, status:'Active', issued:'14 Aug 2026'}
    ],
    admin:{propertyApproval:72, kycQueue:3, paymentExceptions:1, openSettlements:0},
    review:{items:{}, notes:''}
  });

  let state;
  const STORAGE_KEY='oblix-onehomes-prototype-v2';
  try { state = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)) || defaultState(); } catch { state = defaultState(); }
  const save = () => localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
  const money = n => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD',maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(n);
  const money2 = n => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD',minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}).format(n);
  const num = n => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(n);
  const prop = id => PROPERTIES.find(p=>p.id===id) || PROPERTIES[0];
  const currentJurisdiction = () => JURISDICTIONS.find(j=>j.id===state.jurisdiction) || JURISDICTIONS[0];
  const isApprovedJurisdiction = () => currentJurisdiction().status === 'Approved';
  const hasHolding = id => state.holdings.find(h=>h.propertyId===id && h.units>0);

  function toast(message){
    const old=document.querySelector('.toast'); if(old) old.remove();
    const el=document.createElement('div'); el.className='toast'; el.textContent=message; document.body.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),3200);
  }

  function icon(name){
    const icons={
      home:'⌂', shield:'✓', wallet:'◫', cert:'▤', market:'⇄', globe:'◎', admin:'⚙', review:'☑', user:'●', arrow:'→'
    }; return icons[name]||'•';
  }

  function routeTo(hash){ location.hash=hash; window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'}); }
  function parseRoute(){
    const raw=(location.hash||'#home').slice(1); const [path,...rest]=raw.split('/'); return {path:path||'home', id:rest[0]||null};
  }

  function shell(content, active){
    return `
    <div class="app-shell">
      <div class="prototype-banner"><b>CLIENT TESTING PROTOTYPE</b> · No real investment, payment, KYC or token transaction takes place on this site. All figures are illustrative.</div>
      <header class="topbar">
        <div class="topbar-inner">
          <button class="brand" data-route="home" aria-label="Oblix home" style="border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;text-align:left">
            <img class="brand-logo" src="${LOGO_BLACK}" alt="Oblix"><span class="brand-copy"><span>digital.onehomes.com</span></span>
          </button>
          <nav class="nav" aria-label="Primary navigation">
            ${navBtn('Discover','properties',active)}${navBtn('Buyer journey','buyer-journey',active)}${navBtn('Seller center','seller-dashboard',active)}${navBtn('Portfolio','portfolio',active)}${navBtn('Marketplace','marketplace',active)}${navBtn('Certificate','certificate',active)}${navBtn('Features','features',active)}${navBtn('Client review','review',active)}
          </nav>
          <div class="head-actions">
            <span class="pill">${state.role==='seller'?(state.seller.status==='Submitted'?'✓ Seller application submitted':'Property seller demo'):state.role==='admin'?'Admin demo':(state.kycStatus==='Approved'?'✓ Verified buyer':'Buyer demo')}</span>
            <div class="role-switch"><button data-role="buyer" class="${state.role==='buyer'?'active':''}">Buyer</button><button data-role="seller" class="${state.role==='seller'?'active':''}">Seller</button><button data-role="admin" class="${state.role==='admin'?'active':''}">Admin</button></div>
            <button class="icon-btn small" id="resetDemo" title="Reset prototype">Reset</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      <main>${content}</main>
      <footer class="footer"><div class="footer-inner"><div><b>OBLIX</b> · Digital property ownership platform · ${APP_VERSION}</div><div>A OneHomes platform · Technology prototype by OneXfer · ${todayLabel}</div></div></footer>
    </div>`;
  }
  function navBtn(label,path,active){ return `<button data-route="${path}" class="${active===path?'active':''}">${label}</button>`; }

  function render(){
    const r=parseRoute();
    let html;
    switch(r.path){
      case 'properties': html=renderProperties(); break;
      case 'property': html=renderProperty(r.id); break;
      case 'buyer-journey': html=renderBuyerJourney(); break;
      case 'seller-register': html=renderSellerRegister(); break;
      case 'seller-dashboard': html=renderSellerDashboard(); break;
      case 'admin-property': html=renderAdminProperty(); break;
      case 'vault': html=renderVault(); break;
      case 'support': html=renderSupport(); break;
      case 'features': html=renderFeatures(); break;
      case 'onboarding': html=renderOnboarding(); break;
      case 'invest': html=renderInvest(r.id); break;
      case 'portfolio': html=renderPortfolio(); break;
      case 'certificate': html=renderCertificate(r.id); break;
      case 'verify': html=renderVerify(); break;
      case 'marketplace': html=renderMarketplace(); break;
      case 'sell': html=renderSell(r.id); break;
      case 'buy': html=renderBuy(r.id); break;
      case 'matching': html=renderMatching(); break;
      case 'settlement': html=renderSettlement(r.id); break;
      case 'jurisdictions': html=renderJurisdictions(); break;
      case 'admin': html=renderAdmin(); break;
      case 'review': html=renderReview(); break;
      default: html=renderHome();
    }
    root.innerHTML=shell(html,r.path);
    bindCommon(); bindRoute(r);
  }

  function bindCommon(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-route]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>routeTo(b.dataset.route)));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-role]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.role=b.dataset.role;save();routeTo(state.role==='admin'?'admin':state.role==='seller'?'seller-dashboard':'home')}));
    document.getElementById('resetDemo')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(confirm('Reset all prototype data and demo actions?')){state=defaultState();save();toast('Prototype reset');render();}});
  }

  function renderHome(){
    return `
      <section class="hero">
        <div>
          <img class="hero-logo" src="${LOGO_WHITE}" alt="Oblix"><div class="eyebrow">A OneHomes digital property platform · Pakistan pilot</div>
          <h1>A new way into property.</h1>
          <p>Oblix connects verified property buyers with selected OneHomes opportunities and gives eligible property owners or developers a controlled route to submit assets for tokenization review.</p>
          <div class="hero-actions"><button class="primary-btn" data-route="properties">Explore properties</button><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="buyer-journey">Buyer journey</button><button class="ghost-btn" id="startSellerJourney">List / tokenize a property</button><button class="ghost-btn" id="enterVerifiedDemo">Enter verified demo</button></div>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-visual">
          <div class="hero-card"><div class="hero-image"></div><div class="hero-stats"><div class="hero-stat"><small>Demo holding</small><strong>2,500 units</strong></div><div class="hero-stat"><small>Certificate</small><strong>Verified</strong></div><div class="hero-stat"><small>Resale</small><strong>Closed market</strong></div></div></div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <div class="trust-strip">
        <div class="trust-item"><b>Identity first</b><span>KYC/AML and jurisdiction checks before investment or transfer.</span></div>
        <div class="trust-item"><b>Legal structure aligned</b><span>Tokens evidence approved rights linked to an SPV; they do not replace land title.</span></div>
        <div class="trust-item"><b>Verifiable certificate</b><span>Live certificate record, version history, QR verification and downloadable evidence.</span></div>
        <div class="trust-item"><b>Controlled resale</b><span>Verified investors only, periodic matching, partial fills and no liquidity guarantee.</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="section-head"><div><h2>Selected prototype opportunities</h2><p>Client-testing data only. Figures below are intentionally illustrative and must not be treated as an actual offering.</p></div><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="properties">View all</button></div>
      <div class="grid grid-3">${PROPERTIES.map(propertyCard).join('')}</div>
      <div class="section-head"><div><h2>End-to-end ownership journey</h2><p>The prototype follows the agreed flow from discovery and compliance through ownership, portfolio monitoring and a future closed resale market.</p></div></div>
      <div class="flow">${[
        ['Discover','Browse approved properties and documents.'],['Verify','Create account and complete KYC/AML.'],['Invest','Choose amount, accept terms and reconcile payment.'],['Own','Allocate tokens and issue the certificate.'],['Manage','Track holdings, value, income and documents.'],['Resell','List units and match in scheduled windows.']
      ].map((x,i)=>`<div class="flow-step"><div class="num">${i+1}</div><h4>${x[0]}</h4><p>${x[1]}</p></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  function propertyCard(p){
    return `<article class="card property-card"><div class="property-image" style="background-image:url('${p.image}')"><div class="property-tags"><span class="badge dark">${p.status}</span><span class="badge">Prototype</span></div><div class="property-location">${p.city}, ${p.country}</div></div><div class="card-pad"><div class="tiny muted">${p.type} · ${p.bedrooms}</div><h3>${p.name}</h3><div class="muted tiny">${p.strap}</div><div class="stat-row"><div class="stat"><small>Min investment</small><b>${money(p.minInvestment)}</b></div><div class="stat"><small>Token price</small><b>${money2(p.tokenPrice)}</b></div><div class="stat"><small>Illustrative return</small><b>${p.indicativeReturn}%</b></div></div><div class="card-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="property/${p.id}">View opportunity</button><button class="primary-btn" data-route="invest/${p.id}">Invest demo</button></div></div></article>`;
  }

  function renderProperties(){
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Discover</div><h1>Selected properties</h1><p>Compare prototype opportunities and test the investment journey.</p></div><span class="badge warn">Illustrative data — not an offer</span></div>
      <div class="subnav"><button class="active">All available</button><button>Residential</button><button>Lahore</button><button>Islamabad</button><button>Minimum ${money(5000)}</button></div>
      <div class="grid grid-3">${PROPERTIES.map(propertyCard).join('')}</div>
      <div class="notice info mt20"><b>Production rule:</b> property visibility and investment availability will be filtered by investor jurisdiction, eligibility, property approval and regulatory launch state.</div>`;
  }

  function renderProperty(id){
    const p=prop(id); const sold=100-p.available;
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><button class="ghost-btn small" data-route="properties">← Properties</button></div><span class="badge info">Prototype opportunity</span></div>
      <div class="detail-hero">
        <div class="detail-image" style="background-image:url('${p.image}')"><div class="overlay"><div><div class="tiny">${p.city}, ${p.country}</div><h1>${p.name}</h1><div>${p.strap}</div></div></div></div>
        <div class="detail-side">
          <div class="info-panel"><h3>Investment snapshot</h3><div class="info-grid"><div class="info-item"><small>Property value</small><strong>${money(p.value)}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Token price</small><strong>${money2(p.tokenPrice)}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Minimum investment</small><strong>${money(p.minInvestment)}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Illustrative return</small><strong>${p.indicativeReturn}%</strong></div></div><div class="divider"></div><div class="flex between center"><span class="tiny muted">Prototype allocation subscribed</span><b>${sold}%</b></div><div class="progress mt8"><span style="width:${sold}%"></span></div><button class="primary-btn w100 mt20" data-route="invest/${p.id}">Proceed to invest</button></div>
          <div class="risk-note"><b>Important:</b> this prototype demonstrates the proposed experience only. Token rights, return methodology, price, SPV terms, investor eligibility and transfer rights require the approved legal and regulatory structure.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="grid grid-2 mt20">
        <div class="info-panel"><h3>Ownership structure</h3><p class="muted tiny">Property / development asset → dedicated SPV or approved legal structure → investor rights agreement → compliance-enabled property tokens → investor portfolio + digital ownership certificate.</p><div class="info-grid mt16"><div class="info-item"><small>Prototype SPV</small><strong>${p.spv}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Total token supply</small><strong>${num(p.supply)}</strong></div></div></div>
        <div class="info-panel"><h3>Document vault</h3><div class="doc-list">${p.docs.map(d=>`<div class="doc-row"><span>${d}</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="${d}">Preview</button></div>`).join('')}</div></div>
      </div>`;
  }


  function renderBuyerJourney(){
    const steps=[
      ['Discover property','Browse approved properties, token price, minimum investment, documents and risk information.'],
      ['Create buyer account','Name, email, mobile, password, MFA preference and privacy/terms consent.'],
      ['Jurisdiction gate','Determine whether the investor can invest, register interest only, or must be restricted.'],
      ['KYC / AML','Identity, address, sanctions, PEP, source-of-funds and eligibility checks.'],
      ['Choose investment','Enter amount and see token quantity, ownership percentage and illustrative return basis.'],
      ['Accept legal terms','Offering terms, risk disclosure, token terms and certificate disclaimer.'],
      ['Payment & reconciliation','Approved bank/PSP route; funds must reconcile before issuance.'],
      ['Token issuance','Allocate compliance-enabled property units and record the ownership event.'],
      ['Certificate & portfolio','Issue the live certificate, QR verification record, statements and investor vault.'],
      ['Future resale','Eligible holders can list units in the closed marketplace and settle during scheduled windows.']
    ];
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Property buyer experience</div><h1>Buyer / investor journey</h1><p>The end-to-end journey agreed for Oblix: discovery, compliance, investment, ownership evidence, portfolio management and controlled resale.</p></div><span class="badge good">Buyer journey included</span></div>
      <div class="journey-columns"><div class="journey-card"><h3>Primary property investment</h3><p class="muted tiny">From first visit to verified ownership.</p><div class="journey-list">${steps.map((s,i)=>`<div class="journey-step"><div class="jnum">${i+1}</div><div><b>${s[0]}</b><p>${s[1]}</p></div></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="flex gap8 wrap mt20"><button class="primary-btn" data-route="onboarding">Start buyer registration</button><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="properties">Browse properties</button></div></div>
      <div class="journey-card"><h3>Buyer in the resale marketplace</h3><p class="muted tiny">The closed resale market is designed for verified and eligible investors only.</p><div class="journey-list">${[['Verify eligibility','KYC/AML and jurisdiction permissions must remain valid.'],['Register buying interest','Choose property, quantity and maximum bid price.'],['Wait for scheduled window','Orders remain open between monthly or quarterly matching windows.'],['Matching','Price compatibility, time priority, eligibility and quantity determine matches.'],['Settlement funds','Buyer funds are confirmed/reserved before ownership moves.'],['Receive units','Token/ledger balance, ownership register, portfolio and certificate are updated together.']].map((s,i)=>`<div class="journey-step"><div class="jnum">${i+1}</div><div><b>${s[0]}</b><p>${s[1]}</p></div></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="notice warn mt16"><b>No guaranteed execution.</b> Buying interest does not guarantee allocation, and resale price is market-driven within approved controls.</div><button class="secondary-btn mt16" data-route="buy/one-canal">Test buying interest</button></div></div>`;
  }

  function renderSellerRegister(){
    const s=state.seller, p=s.property, prof=s.profile;
    const labels=['Seller profile','KYC / KYB','Property details','Documents & structure','Review & submit'];
    let body='';
    if(s.step===1) body=`<h2>Register as a property seller</h2><p class="muted">For property owners, developers or authorised representatives who want OneHomes/Oblix to assess an asset for digital fractional ownership.</p><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Seller type</label><select id="sellerType"><option ${prof.sellerType==='Property owner'?'selected':''}>Property owner</option><option ${prof.sellerType==='Developer'?'selected':''}>Developer</option><option ${prof.sellerType==='Authorised representative'?'selected':''}>Authorised representative</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Company / organisation (optional)</label><input id="sellerCompany" value="${prof.company||''}" placeholder="Legal entity name"></div><div class="field"><label>Full name</label><input id="sellerName" value="${prof.name}"></div><div class="field"><label>Email</label><input id="sellerEmail" value="${prof.email}"></div><div class="field"><label>Mobile</label><input id="sellerMobile" value="${prof.mobile}"></div><div class="field"><label>Primary jurisdiction</label><select id="sellerJurisdiction"><option value="PK" selected>Pakistan</option><option value="GB">United Kingdom</option><option value="AE">UAE / Dubai</option></select></div><div class="field full"><label class="flex gap8 center"><input id="sellerConsent" type="checkbox" style="width:auto" checked> I consent to identity/KYB, ownership and property due-diligence checks for this prototype journey.</label></div></div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="home">Cancel</button><button class="primary-btn" id="sellerNext">Continue</button></div>`;
    if(s.step===2) body=`<h2>Seller identity / business verification</h2><p class="muted">Production onboarding may require identity, beneficial ownership, sanctions/PEP and corporate verification depending on seller type.</p><div class="info-grid"><div class="info-item"><small>Seller type</small><strong>${prof.sellerType}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Jurisdiction</small><strong>${prof.jurisdiction==='PK'?'Pakistan':prof.jurisdiction}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>KYB/KYC status</small><strong>${s.kybStatus}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Relationship to asset</small><strong>To be evidenced</strong></div></div><div class="notice info mt16">Typical checks: CNIC/passport, company registration where applicable, UBO/authorised signatory, sanctions/PEP, address and evidence of authority to submit the property.</div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" id="sellerBack">Back</button><button class="secondary-btn" id="sellerVerify">Run demo KYC/KYB</button><button class="primary-btn" id="sellerNext" ${s.kybStatus!=='Approved'?'disabled':''}>Continue</button></div>`;
    if(s.step===3) body=`<h2>Property details</h2><p class="muted">Provide enough information for the asset team to determine whether the property is suitable for the tokenization programme.</p><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Property / development name</label><input id="sellerPropertyName" value="${p.name}"></div><div class="field"><label>City</label><input id="sellerPropertyCity" value="${p.city}"></div><div class="field full"><label>Address / development location</label><input id="sellerPropertyAddress" value="${p.address}"></div><div class="field"><label>Property type</label><select id="sellerPropertyType"><option ${p.type==='Residential'?'selected':''}>Residential</option><option>Commercial</option><option>Mixed use</option><option>Land / development</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Indicative property value (USD)</label><input id="sellerPropertyValue" type="number" value="${p.estimatedValue}"></div><div class="field"><label>Title / ownership status</label><select id="sellerTitleStatus"><option ${p.titleStatus==='Owner-held title'?'selected':''}>Owner-held title</option><option>Developer-held / project rights</option><option>Authorised mandate</option><option>Under acquisition</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Current income status</label><select><option>Income producing</option><option>Under development</option><option>Vacant / available</option></select></div></div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" id="sellerBack">Back</button><button class="primary-btn" id="sellerNext">Continue</button></div>`;
    if(s.step===4) body=`<h2>Documents, valuation & proposed structure</h2><p class="muted">Documents are not actually uploaded in this client prototype. The tiles below show the expected production evidence.</p><div class="upload-grid"><div class="upload-tile"><b>Title / ownership evidence</b><span>Deed, allotment, registry extract or approved equivalent</span></div><div class="upload-tile"><b>Seller identity / company documents</b><span>CNIC/passport, incorporation and authorised signatory evidence</span></div><div class="upload-tile"><b>Development approvals / NOCs</b><span>Relevant authority approvals where applicable</span></div><div class="upload-tile"><b>Valuation / feasibility</b><span>Independent or approved valuation evidence</span></div><div class="upload-tile"><b>Tax / insurance / lease documents</b><span>Where applicable to the property and income model</span></div><div class="upload-tile"><b>Photos, plans and investor materials</b><span>Asset imagery, floorplans and disclosures</span></div></div><div class="form-grid mt20"><div class="field"><label>Indicative % proposed for tokenization</label><input id="sellerTargetPercent" type="number" min="1" max="100" value="${p.targetPercent}"></div><div class="field"><label>Proposed investor economics</label><select id="sellerIncomeModel"><option ${p.incomeModel==='Rental income + disposal proceeds'?'selected':''}>Rental income + disposal proceeds</option><option>Defined project return</option><option>Sale proceeds only</option></select></div></div><div class="notice warn mt16"><b>Not self-service issuance.</b> Seller preferences are inputs only. SPV structure, valuation, token economics, minimum investment and investor rights require legal, compliance and OneHomes approval.</div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" id="sellerBack">Back</button><button class="secondary-btn" id="sellerDocs">${s.docsReady?'✓ Demo evidence marked ready':'Mark demo evidence ready'}</button><button class="primary-btn" id="sellerNext" ${!s.docsReady?'disabled':''}>Review</button></div>`;
    if(s.step===5) body=`<h2>Review property submission</h2><div class="info-grid"><div class="info-item"><small>Seller</small><strong>${prof.name}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Seller type</small><strong>${prof.sellerType}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Property</small><strong>${p.name}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Location</small><strong>${p.city}, Pakistan</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Indicative value</small><strong>${money(Number(p.estimatedValue)||0)}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Proposed tokenization</small><strong>${p.targetPercent}%</strong></div></div><div class="notice warn mt16"><b>Submission is not acceptance.</b> OneHomes/Oblix may require title verification, valuation, legal structuring, regulatory review, banking/payment feasibility and additional due diligence before a property can be published or tokenized.</div><label class="flex gap8 center mt16"><input id="sellerDeclare" type="checkbox" style="width:auto"> I confirm the information supplied for this prototype review is accurate and I am authorised to submit the property.</label><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" id="sellerBack">Back</button><button class="primary-btn" id="sellerSubmit">Submit for due diligence</button></div>`;
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Property seller onboarding</div><h1>List a property for tokenization review</h1><p>This journey is separate from investor resale: it is for the legal owner/developer submitting a physical property or development to the Oblix platform.</p></div><span class="badge info">Seller registration</span></div><div class="form-shell">${stepper(labels,s.step)}<div class="form-card">${body}</div></div>`;
  }

  function renderSellerDashboard(){
    const s=state.seller, p=s.property;
    if(s.status!=='Submitted') return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Property seller center</div><h1>Seller / developer portal</h1><p>Register a seller profile and submit a property for due diligence, valuation and tokenization assessment.</p></div></div><div class="seller-hero"><div class="seller-panel"><img class="hero-logo" src="${LOGO_WHITE}" alt="Oblix"><h2>Bring an eligible property into the digital ownership programme.</h2><p>Oblix is designed to collect seller identity, ownership evidence, property documents and commercial inputs before OneHomes legal, compliance and asset teams approve tokenization.</p><div class="seller-flow"><div class="flow-mini">1 · Register seller</div><div class="flow-mini">2 · Verify identity/KYB</div><div class="flow-mini">3 · Submit property</div><div class="flow-mini">4 · Due diligence</div></div></div><div class="info-panel"><h3>What sellers should expect</h3><div class="journey-list">${[['Ownership verification','Evidence must show the seller/developer is legally entitled to submit the asset.'],['Property due diligence','Title, approvals, valuation, insurance and project information are reviewed.'],['Legal/SPV design','The legal wrapper and investor rights are approved before issuance.'],['Commercial design','Token supply, price, minimum investment and distribution logic are configured.'],['Approval before publication','No property appears to investors until required approvals are complete.']].map((x,i)=>`<div class="journey-step"><div class="jnum">${i+1}</div><div><b>${x[0]}</b><p>${x[1]}</p></div></div>`).join('')}</div><button class="primary-btn w100 mt20" data-route="seller-register">Start seller registration</button></div></div>`;
    const stages=[['Seller registration','Completed'],['KYC / KYB','Completed'],['Ownership & title review','Current'],['Independent / approved valuation','Pending'],['SPV & legal structure','Pending'],['Token economics & disclosures','Pending'],['Internal / regulatory approvals','Pending'],['Publish to investors','Pending']];
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Property seller center</div><h1>${p.name}</h1><p>Seller application ${s.applicationId} · Submitted for due diligence.</p></div><span class="badge warn">Due diligence</span></div><div class="metrics"><div class="metric"><small>Application</small><strong>${s.applicationId}</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Indicative value</small><strong>${money(Number(p.estimatedValue)||0)}</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Proposed tokenization</small><strong>${p.targetPercent}%</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Current stage</small><strong>Title review</strong></div></div><div class="seller-status"><div class="info-panel"><h3>Onboarding and approval journey</h3>${stages.map((x,i)=>`<div class="seller-stage ${i<2?'done':i===2?'active':''}"><div class="circle">${i<2?'✓':i+1}</div><div><b>${x[0]}</b><div class="tiny muted">${i===2?'OneHomes legal/property team review in progress':x[1]}</div></div><span class="badge ${i<2?'good':i===2?'info':''}">${x[1]}</span></div>`).join('')}</div><aside class="info-panel"><h3>Seller record</h3><div class="doc-list"><div class="doc-row"><span>Seller / company</span><b>${s.profile.name}</b></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Property type</span><b>${p.type}</b></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Location</span><b>${p.city}</b></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Title status</span><b>${p.titleStatus}</b></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Income model</span><b>${p.incomeModel}</b></div></div><div class="divider"></div><button class="ghost-btn w100" data-route="property/one-canal">Preview buyer-facing property page</button><button class="secondary-btn w100 mt8" id="sellerNewApp">Submit another property</button></aside></div>`;
  }

  function renderVault(){
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Investor services</div><h1>Investor vault, statements & support</h1><p>One place for ownership evidence, income statements, property documents, notifications and support cases.</p></div><span class="badge good">Secure investor area</span></div><div class="vault-grid"><div><div class="info-panel"><h3>Statements & documents</h3><div class="doc-list"><div class="doc-row"><span>Digital ownership certificate</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-route="certificate">Open</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>September 2026 portfolio statement</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="Portfolio statement">Preview</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Income distribution statement · Aug 2026</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="Income distribution statement">Preview</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Current valuation summary</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="Valuation summary">Preview</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>SPV / offering documents</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-route="property/one-canal">Open</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Transaction history</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="Transaction history">Preview</button></div></div></div><div class="info-panel mt20"><h3>Income history</h3><div class="queue"><div class="queue-row"><strong>31 Aug 2026</strong><span>Illustrative distribution</span><span class="badge good">USD 480</span></div><div class="queue-row"><strong>31 Jul 2026</strong><span>Illustrative distribution</span><span class="badge good">USD 472</span></div><div class="queue-row"><strong>30 Jun 2026</strong><span>Illustrative distribution</span><span class="badge good">USD 473</span></div></div></div></div><aside><div class="info-panel"><h3>Notifications</h3>${state.notifications.map(n=>`<div class="support-case"><b>${n.title}</b><div class="tiny muted mt8">${n.date}</div><p class="tiny muted">${n.body}</p></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="info-panel mt20"><h3>Need help?</h3><p class="tiny muted">Raise a prototype support case against a property, payment, certificate, statement or marketplace transaction.</p><button class="primary-btn w100" data-route="support">Open support center</button></div></aside></div>`;
  }

  function renderSupport(){
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Investor support</div><h1>Support center</h1><p>Prototype workflow for tracked investor enquiries and operational exceptions.</p></div></div><div class="grid grid-2"><div class="form-card"><h3>Raise a support case</h3><div class="field"><label>Category</label><select id="supportCategory"><option>Property / documents</option><option>Payment / reconciliation</option><option>Certificate</option><option>Portfolio / statement</option><option>Marketplace / settlement</option></select></div><div class="field mt16"><label>Message</label><textarea id="supportMessage" placeholder="Describe the issue or question..."></textarea></div><button class="primary-btn mt16" id="submitSupport">Submit case</button></div><div class="info-panel"><h3>Your cases</h3><div class="support-list">${state.supportCases.length?state.supportCases.slice().reverse().map(c=>`<div class="support-case"><div class="flex between center"><b>${c.id}</b><span class="badge info">${c.status}</span></div><div class="tiny muted mt8">${c.category} · ${c.date}</div><p class="tiny muted">${c.message}</p></div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty">No support cases yet</div>'}</div></div></div>`;
  }

  function renderFeatures(){
    const groups=[
      ['Buyer / Investor',['Public landing and property discovery','Buyer account registration, password/MFA and consent','Jurisdiction gate and KYC/AML','Property detail, documents and calculator','Investment checkout and payment reconciliation','Token issuance receipt and ownership record']],
      ['Ownership & Portfolio',['Digital ownership certificate','QR / certificate verification and version history','Portfolio value, holdings and income','Investor document vault and statements','Notifications and tracked support cases','On-chain/off-chain privacy model represented in flows']],
      ['Property Seller',['Seller / developer registration','KYC/KYB and authority checks','Property submission and ownership evidence','Document, approval and valuation requirements','Legal/SPV and tokenization readiness journey','Seller application status dashboard']],
      ['Closed Resale Marketplace',['Seller listings at any time','Buyer interest / bid registration','Scheduled monthly/quarterly matching','Price/time/eligibility/quantity logic','Partial fills and unmatched orders','Payment → token → ownership → certificate settlement sync']],
      ['Admin & Compliance',['Property seller application queue','Property onboarding and publish workflow','KYC/AML manual-review queue','Payment and issuance exception controls','Certificate and marketplace operations','Jurisdiction/API readiness and audit controls']],
      ['Client / Delivery Controls',['Prototype review and notes export','Phase 0–7 roadmap','No liquidity guarantee messaging','No public land-title overclaim','External API/regulatory dependency limitations','Client sign-off feature checklist']]
    ];
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Client test coverage</div><h1>Agreed feature matrix</h1><p>This page maps the original Oblix mockups plus the signed scope extensions into one prototype testing checklist.</p></div><span class="badge good">Prototype v2.0</span></div><div class="feature-grid">${groups.map(g=>`<div class="feature-card"><h3>${g[0]}</h3><ul>${g[1].map(x=>`<li>${x}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="flex gap8 wrap mt20"><button class="primary-btn" data-route="buyer-journey">Test buyer journey</button><button class="secondary-btn" data-route="seller-dashboard">Test seller journey</button><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="marketplace">Test marketplace</button><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="admin">Test admin</button><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="review">Client review</button></div>`;
  }

  function renderOnboarding(){
    const j=currentJurisdiction(); const status = isApprovedJurisdiction() ? 'Approved for prototype investment' : j.status==='Restricted'?'Investment blocked in prototype':'Interest registration only';
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Investor onboarding</div><h1>Verify before you invest.</h1><p>Prototype KYC/AML and jurisdiction workflow. Do not enter real identity information.</p></div><span class="badge ${state.kycStatus==='Approved'?'good':'warn'}">KYC: ${state.kycStatus}</span></div>
      <div class="form-shell">
        ${stepper(['Account','Jurisdiction','Identity & AML','Eligibility'], state.kycStatus==='Approved'?4:2)}
        <div class="form-card"><h2>Jurisdiction & identity check</h2><p class="muted">The production platform uses country-specific rules, KYC/AML providers and payment controls. This prototype simulates the decision only.</p>
          <div class="notice ${j.class==='good'?'good':j.class==='danger'?'danger':'warn'} mt16"><b>${j.name}: ${j.status}.</b> ${status}. Production access remains subject to legal, regulatory, KYC/AML, payment and data-protection approval.</div>
          <div class="form-grid">
            <div class="field"><label for="jcountry">Country / investor jurisdiction</label><select id="jcountry">${JURISDICTIONS.map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}" ${x.id===state.jurisdiction?'selected':''}>${x.name}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Investor type</label><select id="investorType"><option>Individual</option><option>Company / institution</option></select></div>
            <div class="field"><label>First name</label><input value="Demo" aria-label="First name"></div><div class="field"><label>Last name</label><input value="Investor" aria-label="Last name"></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Email</label><input value="demo@example.com" aria-label="Email"></div><div class="field"><label>Mobile</label><input value="+44 7000 000000" aria-label="Mobile"></div><div class="field"><label>Password</label><input type="password" value="Prototype123!" aria-label="Password"></div><div class="field"><label>MFA preference</label><select><option>Authenticator app</option><option>SMS</option><option>Email code</option></select></div><div class="field full"><label class="flex gap8 center"><input type="checkbox" style="width:auto" checked> I agree to the Terms, Privacy Policy and jurisdiction-specific investor disclosures for this prototype.</label></div>
            <div class="field full"><label>Identity verification</label><div class="notice info">In production this step is provided through an approved KYC provider and may include identity, address, sanctions, PEP, source-of-funds and manual-review checks. No documents are uploaded in this prototype.</div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="home">Back</button><button class="primary-btn" id="runKyc">Run demo verification</button></div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function stepper(labels,active){ return `<aside class="stepper">${labels.map((x,i)=>`<div class="stepper-row ${i+1<active?'done':i+1===active?'active':''}"><div class="dot">${i+1<active?'✓':i+1}</div><div><b>${x}</b><span>${i+1<active?'Completed':i+1===active?'Current step':'Pending'}</span></div></div>`).join('')}</aside>`; }

  function renderInvest(id){
    const p=prop(id||state.selectedProperty); state.selectedProperty=p.id;
    const units=Math.floor(state.investAmount/p.tokenPrice); const pct=(units/p.supply*100).toFixed(4);
    const j=currentJurisdiction();
    if(state.kycStatus!=='Approved' || !isApprovedJurisdiction()){
      return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Investment gate</div><h1>Verification required</h1><p>Investment remains disabled until investor KYC/AML and jurisdiction rules are approved.</p></div></div><div class="form-card"><div class="notice ${j.status==='Restricted'?'danger':'warn'}"><b>${j.name}: ${j.status}.</b> ${j.access}</div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="property/${p.id}">Back to property</button><button class="primary-btn" data-route="onboarding">Complete onboarding</button></div></div>`;
    }
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Investment checkout</div><h1>Invest in ${p.name}</h1><p>Four-step demo from amount selection to token issuance and certificate.</p></div><span class="badge good">Eligible · ${j.name}</span></div>
      <div class="form-shell">
        ${stepper(['Investment','Legal terms','Payment','Ownership'],state.investStep)}
        <div class="form-card">${investStepContent(p,units,pct)}</div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function investStepContent(p,units,pct){
    if(state.investStep===1) return `<h2>Choose your investment</h2><p class="muted">Enter an illustrative amount. Token quantity and ownership percentage update automatically.</p><div class="form-grid"><div class="field full"><label>Investment amount (USD)</label><input id="investmentAmount" type="number" min="${p.minInvestment}" step="1000" value="${state.investAmount}"></div></div><div class="grid grid-3 mt20"><div class="metric"><small>Token price</small><strong>${money2(p.tokenPrice)}</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Tokens</small><strong>${num(units)}</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Ownership</small><strong>${pct}%</strong></div></div><div class="notice info mt16">Estimated returns shown elsewhere in the prototype are illustrative only and are not guaranteed.</div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="property/${p.id}">Back</button><button class="primary-btn" id="investNext1">Review terms</button></div>`;
    if(state.investStep===2) return `<h2>Review legal terms</h2><p class="muted">The production flow records versioned acceptance of the offering terms, risk disclosure, token terms and certificate disclaimer.</p><div class="doc-list mt20"><div class="doc-row"><span>Offering memorandum · Prototype v1.0</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="Offering memorandum">Preview</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Risk disclosure · Prototype v1.0</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="Risk disclosure">Preview</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Token and transfer terms · Prototype v1.0</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="Token terms">Preview</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Certificate legal disclaimer</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="Certificate disclaimer">Preview</button></div></div><label class="check mt20"><input type="checkbox" id="termsAccepted" ${state.termsAccepted?'checked':''}><span>I confirm that I have reviewed the prototype terms and understand that this demo does not create any actual investment or legal rights.</span></label><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" id="investBack1">Back</button><button class="primary-btn" id="investNext2" ${state.termsAccepted?'':'disabled'}>Continue to payment</button></div>`;
    if(state.investStep===3) return `<h2>Payment & reconciliation</h2><p class="muted">Production token issuance occurs only after approved payment/escrow confirmation and reconciliation.</p><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Payment method</label><select id="paymentMethod"><option ${state.paymentMethod==='Bank transfer'?'selected':''}>Bank transfer</option><option ${state.paymentMethod==='Card / PSP'?'selected':''}>Card / PSP</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Order value</label><input value="${money(state.investAmount)}" disabled></div><div class="field full"><div class="notice warn"><b>Prototype only:</b> clicking “Simulate payment” does not charge a card, connect to a bank or transfer funds.</div></div></div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" id="investBack2">Back</button><button class="primary-btn" id="simulatePayment">Simulate payment & reconciliation</button></div>`;
    return `<h2>Ownership issued</h2><div class="notice good"><b>Demo issuance complete.</b> Payment was simulated as reconciled, tokens allocated to the controlled ledger and a certificate record generated.</div><div class="grid grid-3 mt20"><div class="metric"><small>Tokens issued</small><strong>${num(units)}</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Ownership</small><strong>${pct}%</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Status</small><strong>Confirmed</strong></div></div><div class="timeline mt20"><div class="timeline-row done"><div class="timeline-num">✓</div><div><b>Payment reconciled</b><p>Prototype payment reference recorded.</p></div><span class="badge good">Done</span></div><div class="timeline-row done"><div class="timeline-num">✓</div><div><b>Token allocation</b><p>Compliance-enabled units allocated to investor account.</p></div><span class="badge good">Done</span></div><div class="timeline-row done"><div class="timeline-num">✓</div><div><b>Certificate generated</b><p>Certificate linked to property, SPV, token holding and demo transaction evidence.</p></div><span class="badge good">Done</span></div></div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="certificate/${p.id}">View certificate</button><button class="primary-btn" data-route="portfolio">Open portfolio</button></div>`;
  }

  function renderPortfolio(){
    const totalInvested=state.holdings.reduce((s,h)=>s+h.units*h.avgPrice,0); const current=state.holdings.reduce((s,h)=>s+h.units*h.currentPrice,0); const income=state.holdings.reduce((s,h)=>s+h.income,0);
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Investor dashboard</div><h1>Your portfolio</h1><p>Follow value, income, certificates, documents and resale eligibility in one place.</p></div><div class="flex gap8 wrap"><span class="badge good">KYC approved</span><span class="badge info">${currentJurisdiction().name}</span></div></div>
      <div class="metrics"><div class="metric"><small>Total invested</small><strong>${money(totalInvested)}</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Current demo value</small><strong>${money(current)}</strong><div class="trend">Illustrative +${totalInvested?((current/totalInvested-1)*100).toFixed(1):0}%</div></div><div class="metric"><small>Total income</small><strong>${money(income)}</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Next distribution</small><strong>31 Oct</strong></div></div>
      <div class="section-head"><div><h2>Property holdings</h2><p>Your ownership records and certificates.</p></div><div class="flex gap8 wrap"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="vault">Investor vault & support</button><button class="primary-btn" data-route="properties">Invest more</button></div></div>
      <div class="grid">${state.holdings.length?state.holdings.map(holdingRow).join(''):`<div class="empty"><strong>No holdings yet</strong>Complete the investment demo to create a prototype holding.</div>`}</div>
      <div class="grid grid-2 mt20"><div class="info-panel"><h3>Recent activity</h3><div class="timeline"><div class="timeline-row done"><div class="timeline-num">✓</div><div><b>Certificate OH-2026-00845 issued</b><p>One Canal Road · Version 2 · 14 Aug 2026</p></div><span class="badge good">Verified</span></div><div class="timeline-row"><div class="timeline-num">$</div><div><b>Income distribution recorded</b><p>Illustrative portfolio distribution · 31 Aug 2026</p></div><span class="badge info">Statement</span></div></div></div><div class="info-panel"><h3>Investor vault</h3><div class="doc-list"><div class="doc-row"><span>Ownership certificates</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-route="certificate">Open</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Income statements</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="Income statement">Preview</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Property documents</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-route="property/one-canal">Open</button></div><div class="doc-row"><span>Transaction history</span><button class="ghost-btn small" data-demo-doc="Transaction history">Preview</button></div></div></div></div>`;
  }

  function holdingRow(h){ const p=prop(h.propertyId); const value=h.units*h.currentPrice; const pct=(h.units/p.supply*100).toFixed(4); return `<div class="holding"><div class="holding-img" style="background-image:url('${p.image}')"></div><div><h3>${p.name}</h3><div class="tiny muted">${p.city}, Pakistan · ${h.status}</div><div class="holding-meta"><span><small>Tokens held</small><b>${num(h.units)}</b></span><span><small>Ownership</small><b>${pct}%</b></span><span><small>Current value</small><b>${money(value)}</b></span><span><small>Income</small><b>${money(h.income)}</b></span></div></div><div class="holding-actions"><button class="primary-btn small" data-route="sell/${p.id}">Sell units</button><button class="ghost-btn small" data-route="certificate/${p.id}">Certificate</button><button class="ghost-btn small" data-route="property/${p.id}">View property</button></div></div>`; }

  function renderCertificate(propertyId){
    const wanted=propertyId||state.selectedProperty||'one-canal'; const active=state.certificateHistory.find(c=>c.status==='Active'&&c.propertyId===wanted)||state.certificateHistory.find(c=>c.status==='Active')||state.certificateHistory[state.certificateHistory.length-1]; const p=prop(active.propertyId); const h=hasHolding(p.id); const units=h?h.units:active.units; const pct=(units/p.supply*100).toFixed(4);
    return `<div class="page-head print-hide"><div><div class="eyebrow">Ownership evidence</div><h1>Digital ownership certificate</h1><p>Live verifiable record with downloadable/printable evidence and version history.</p></div><div class="flex gap8"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="verify">Verify a certificate</button><button class="primary-btn" id="printCert">Print / Save PDF</button></div></div>
      <div class="cert-wrap"><div class="certificate"><div class="cert-head"><img class="cert-logo" src="${LOGO_BLACK}" alt="Oblix"><div class="oblix-watermark">A OneHomes property platform</div><h1>Digital Property Investment Ownership Certificate</h1><p>Certificate ${active.id} · Version ${active.version} · ${active.status}</p></div><div class="cert-grid"><div class="cert-field"><small>Investor</small><b>Demo Investor</b></div><div class="cert-field"><small>Property</small><b>${p.name}, ${p.city}</b></div><div class="cert-field"><small>Legal vehicle</small><b>${p.spv}</b></div><div class="cert-field"><small>Tokens held</small><b>${num(units)}</b></div><div class="cert-field"><small>Ownership interest</small><b>${pct}%</b></div><div class="cert-field"><small>Issue date</small><b>${active.issued}</b></div><div class="cert-field"><small>Account / wallet reference</small><b>INV-000184 · 0x79A3…2048</b></div><div class="cert-field"><small>Certificate hash</small><b>SHA256: 9A71…C42E</b></div></div><div class="cert-foot"><div class="cert-note"><b>Legal disclaimer.</b><br>This certificate evidences the stated prototype token holding linked to the property/SPV structure. It is not a land-title deed and does not create legal rights in this testing environment. Production wording is subject to approved legal and regulatory terms.<div class="mt16"><b>Digitally signed:</b> Oblix / OneHomes Digital Assets · Prototype signature</div></div>${qr()}</div></div></div>
      <div class="section-head print-hide"><div><h2>Certificate history</h2><p>Resale can supersede or amend the seller certificate and issue/update the buyer certificate.</p></div></div><div class="grid print-hide">${state.certificateHistory.slice().reverse().map(c=>`<div class="timeline-row ${c.status==='Active'?'active':'done'}"><div class="timeline-num">${c.version}</div><div><b>${c.id} · Version ${c.version}</b><p>${prop(c.propertyId).name} · ${num(c.units)} units · Issued ${c.issued}</p></div><span class="badge ${c.status==='Active'?'good':'warn'}">${c.status}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  function qr(){ const bits=Array.from({length:81},(_,i)=>`<i style="background:${([0,1,3,4,8,10,12,14,17,18,20,22,24,27,29,31,34,36,40,42,44,46,49,51,53,57,59,60,62,64,67,69,71,73,75,77,80].includes(i)?'#101828':'#fff')}"></i>`).join(''); return `<div class="qr" aria-label="Prototype QR code">${bits}</div>`; }

  function renderVerify(){
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Public verification</div><h1>Verify certificate</h1><p>Check whether a certificate is active, superseded or revoked without exposing KYC documents.</p></div></div><div class="grid grid-2"><div class="form-card"><h2>Certificate lookup</h2><div class="form-grid"><div class="field full"><label>Certificate number</label><input id="certLookup" value="OH-2026-00845"></div></div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="certificate">Back</button><button class="primary-btn" id="verifyCert">Verify</button></div></div><div id="verifyResult" class="info-panel"><h3>Verification result</h3><p class="muted tiny">Enter a certificate number to check its demo status.</p></div></div>`;
  }

  function renderMarketplace(){
    const asks=[...state.marketAsks,...state.sellOrders].filter(o=>o.status==='Open'&&o.propertyId==='one-canal').sort((a,b)=>a.price-b.price||a.created.localeCompare(b.created));
    const bids=state.buyOrders.filter(o=>o.status==='Open'&&o.propertyId==='one-canal').sort((a,b)=>b.price-a.price||a.created.localeCompare(b.created));
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Phase 6 prototype</div><h1>Closed resale marketplace</h1><p>Verified investors can list units or register buying interest at any time. Matching and settlement occur in scheduled windows.</p></div><span class="badge dark">Verified investors only</span></div>
      <div class="market-journeys"><div class="market-role"><div class="eyebrow">Seller journey</div><h3>List an existing token holding</h3><p class="tiny muted">Select units → transfer checks → asking price → active listing → scheduled match → settlement → certificate update.</p><div class="mini-steps"><span>Verified holder</span><span>Partial fills</span><span>No guaranteed buyer</span></div><button class="primary-btn small" data-route="sell/one-canal">Test seller resale</button></div><div class="market-role"><div class="eyebrow">Buyer journey</div><h3>Register buying interest</h3><p class="tiny muted">Verify eligibility → choose quantity → maximum bid → scheduled match → fund settlement → receive units and updated certificate.</p><div class="mini-steps"><span>Verified buyer</span><span>Price/time priority</span><span>Periodic settlement</span></div><button class="secondary-btn small" data-route="buy/one-canal">Test buyer interest</button></div></div>
      <div class="market-summary"><div class="orderbook"><div class="book-side"><div class="book-title"><b>Sell listings</b><span class="ask">Seller ask</span></div><div class="book-row header"><span>Units</span><span>Ask</span><span>Time</span></div>${asks.length?asks.map(o=>`<div class="book-row"><span>${num(o.units)}</span><b class="ask">${money2(o.price)}</b><span>${o.created.split(' ')[0]} ${o.created.split(' ')[1]}</span></div>`).join(''):`<div class="empty">No active asks</div>`}</div><div class="book-side"><div class="book-title"><b>Buying interest</b><span class="bid">Buyer bid</span></div><div class="book-row header"><span>Units</span><span>Bid</span><span>Time</span></div>${bids.map(o=>`<div class="book-row"><span>${num(o.units)}</span><b class="bid">${money2(o.price)}</b><span>${o.created.split(' ')[0]} ${o.created.split(' ')[1]}</span></div>`).join('')}</div></div>
        <div class="window-card"><div class="tiny">NEXT SCHEDULED WINDOW</div><h3>${matchingDate}</h3><p>Periodic matching based on price compatibility, time priority, investor eligibility and available quantity. Final settlement requires a compliance re-check and buyer funds confirmation.</p><div class="countdown"><div><b>12</b><span>days</span></div><div><b>09</b><span>hours</span></div><div><b>30</b><span>mins</span></div></div><button class="primary-btn w100" style="background:#fff;color:#0b1731" data-route="matching">Preview matching</button></div></div>
      <div class="grid grid-2 mt20"><div class="info-panel"><h3>Your marketplace actions</h3><div class="flex gap8 wrap"><button class="primary-btn" data-route="sell/one-canal">List units to sell</button><button class="secondary-btn" data-route="buy/one-canal">Register buying interest</button></div><div class="divider"></div><div class="tiny muted">Your open sell listings: ${state.sellOrders.filter(o=>o.status==='Open').length} · Open buy interests: ${state.buyOrders.filter(o=>o.userOwned&&o.status==='Open').length}</div></div><div class="info-panel"><h3>Reference information</h3><div class="info-grid"><div class="info-item"><small>Reference NAV</small><strong>${money2(10.40)}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Last demo match</small><strong>${money2(10.50)}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Highest bid</small><strong>${bids.length?money2(bids[0].price):'—'}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Lowest ask</small><strong>${asks.length?money2(asks[0].price):'—'}</strong></div></div></div></div>
      <div class="market-disclaimer"><div><b>No liquidity pool.</b><br>OneHomes/Oblix does not act as principal buyer in the proposed model.</div><div><b>No guaranteed buyer.</b><br>Unmatched quantities can remain open, be amended or cancelled.</div><div><b>No guaranteed price.</b><br>Price is market-driven between eligible buyer bids and seller asks within approved controls.</div></div>`;
  }

  function renderSell(id){
    const p=prop(id); const h=hasHolding(p.id); if(!h) return `<div class="empty"><strong>No eligible holding</strong>You need a demo holding before you can create a sell listing.<div class="mt16"><button class="primary-btn" data-route="portfolio">Open portfolio</button></div></div>`;
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Seller journey</div><h1>List ${p.name} units</h1><p>Create a persistent sell listing for the next scheduled matching window.</p></div><span class="badge info">Available: ${num(h.units)} units</span></div>
      <div class="form-shell">${stepper(['Select units','Compliance','Publish listing','Scheduled match'],1)}<div class="form-card"><h2>Create sell listing</h2><div class="notice info">A listing does not guarantee a sale. Partial fills are supported and unmatched units can remain open for later windows.</div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Units to sell</label><input id="sellUnits" type="number" min="1" max="${h.units}" value="500"></div><div class="field"><label>Minimum price per unit</label><input id="sellPrice" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" value="10.50"></div><div class="field"><label>Reference NAV</label><input value="${money2(10.40)}" disabled></div><div class="field"><label>Next matching window</label><input value="${matchingDate}" disabled></div></div><div class="divider"></div><div class="timeline"><div class="timeline-row done"><div class="timeline-num">✓</div><div><b>KYC/AML status</b><p>Investor remains approved in prototype.</p></div><span class="badge good">Passed</span></div><div class="timeline-row done"><div class="timeline-num">✓</div><div><b>Jurisdiction</b><p>${currentJurisdiction().name} · demo access enabled.</p></div><span class="badge good">Allowed</span></div><div class="timeline-row done"><div class="timeline-num">✓</div><div><b>Available balance</b><p>${num(h.units)} units available to list.</p></div><span class="badge good">Passed</span></div></div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="marketplace">Cancel</button><button class="primary-btn" id="publishSell">Publish listing</button></div></div></div>`;
  }

  function renderBuy(id){
    const p=prop(id); return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Buyer journey</div><h1>Register buying interest</h1><p>Submit quantity and maximum bid for ${p.name}. Matching occurs only in the scheduled window.</p></div></div><div class="form-card"><h2>Buying interest</h2><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Units wanted</label><input id="buyUnits" type="number" min="1" value="400"></div><div class="field"><label>Maximum price per unit</label><input id="buyPrice" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" value="10.55"></div><div class="field"><label>Reference NAV</label><input value="${money2(10.40)}" disabled></div><div class="field"><label>Next matching window</label><input value="${matchingDate}" disabled></div></div><div class="notice warn mt16">A buy interest is not an executed trade. Buyer funds are confirmed/reserved only after a compatible match and final eligibility check.</div><div class="form-actions"><button class="ghost-btn" data-route="marketplace">Cancel</button><button class="primary-btn" id="publishBuy">Submit buying interest</button></div></div>`;
  }

  function computeMatches(){
    const asks=[...state.marketAsks,...state.sellOrders].filter(o=>o.status==='Open'&&o.propertyId==='one-canal').map(o=>({...o,remaining:o.units})).sort((a,b)=>a.price-b.price||a.created.localeCompare(b.created));
    const bids=state.buyOrders.filter(o=>o.status==='Open'&&o.propertyId==='one-canal').map(o=>({...o,remaining:o.units})).sort((a,b)=>b.price-a.price||a.created.localeCompare(b.created));
    const matches=[];
    for(const ask of asks){
      for(const bid of bids){
        if(ask.remaining<=0) break; if(bid.remaining<=0) continue; if(bid.price<ask.price) continue;
        const qty=Math.min(ask.remaining,bid.remaining); const price=ask.price;
        matches.push({askId:ask.id,bidId:bid.id,units:qty,price,propertyId:'one-canal',userSeller:ask.userOwned||false,userBuyer:bid.userOwned||false});
        ask.remaining-=qty; bid.remaining-=qty;
      }
    }
    return matches;
  }

  function renderMatching(){
    const matches=computeMatches(); const total=matches.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.units,0); const userMatches=matches.filter(m=>m.userSeller||m.userBuyer);
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Periodic order book</div><h1>Matching window preview</h1><p>Demo engine applies price compatibility, time priority, investor eligibility and available quantity.</p></div><span class="badge info">${matchingDate}</span></div>
      <div class="metrics"><div class="metric"><small>Compatible matches</small><strong>${matches.length}</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Units matched</small><strong>${num(total)}</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>User-involved matches</small><strong>${userMatches.length}</strong></div><div class="metric"><small>Settlement state</small><strong>Not started</strong></div></div>
      <div class="section-head"><div><h2>Matching results</h2><p>This preview does not move tokens or funds. A match becomes a settlement candidate only.</p></div></div>
      <div class="grid">${matches.length?matches.map((m,i)=>`<div class="timeline-row ${m.userSeller||m.userBuyer?'active':''}"><div class="timeline-num">${i+1}</div><div><b>${num(m.units)} units @ ${money2(m.price)}</b><p>Sell ${m.askId} matched with buy ${m.bidId}${m.userSeller?' · Your sell listing':''}${m.userBuyer?' · Your buy interest':''}</p></div><span class="badge ${m.userSeller||m.userBuyer?'info':'good'}">Compatible</span></div>`).join(''):`<div class="empty"><strong>No compatible orders</strong>No buyer bid currently meets an eligible seller ask.</div>`}</div>
      <div class="grid grid-2 mt20"><div class="info-panel"><h3>Matching priority</h3><ol class="tiny muted"><li>Price compatibility — buyer maximum must meet seller minimum.</li><li>Time priority — earlier eligible orders win at equal price.</li><li>Investor eligibility — both parties must remain allowed.</li><li>Available quantity — full and partial fills supported.</li><li>Final compliance and funds check before settlement.</li></ol></div><div class="info-panel"><h3>Admin simulation</h3><p class="tiny muted">Run the demo window to create settlement candidates. Real production operation would require approved legal/regulatory launch gates and payment/escrow integration.</p><button class="primary-btn w100" id="runMatching" ${matches.length?'':'disabled'}>Run demo matching window</button></div></div>`;
  }

  function renderSettlement(id){
    const s=state.settlements.find(x=>x.id===id) || state.settlements[0];
    if(!s) return `<div class="empty"><strong>No settlement yet</strong>Run the demo matching window first.<div class="mt16"><button class="primary-btn" data-route="matching">Open matching window</button></div></div>`;
    const steps=['Buyer funds reserved','Final compliance re-check','Token / ledger transfer','Ownership register update','Portfolio synchronization','Certificate refresh'];
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Controlled settlement</div><h1>Settlement ${s.id}</h1><p>${num(s.units)} ${prop(s.propertyId).name} units @ ${money2(s.price)}.</p></div><span class="badge ${s.step>=6?'good':'warn'}">${s.step>=6?'Completed':'In progress'}</span></div>
      <div class="grid grid-2"><div class="info-panel"><h3>Settlement sequence</h3><div class="timeline">${steps.map((x,i)=>`<div class="timeline-row ${i+1<s.step?'done':i+1===s.step?'active':''}"><div class="timeline-num">${i+1<s.step?'✓':i+1}</div><div><b>${x}</b><p>${i+1<s.step?'Completed in prototype':i+1===s.step?'Current step':'Pending'}</p></div><span class="badge ${i+1<s.step?'good':i+1===s.step?'info':''}">${i+1<s.step?'Done':i+1===s.step?'Current':'Pending'}</span></div>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="info-panel"><h3>Synchronization rule</h3><p class="tiny muted">Ownership does not move merely because orders matched. The platform confirms buyer funds and final compliance first, then transfers tokens, updates the ownership register, synchronizes portfolios and refreshes certificate versions.</p><div class="notice warn mt16">No real funds or tokens move in this prototype.</div><button class="primary-btn w100 mt20" id="advanceSettlement" ${s.step>=7?'disabled':''}>${s.step>=6?'Finalize settlement':'Advance demo step'}</button>${s.step>=7?`<button class="secondary-btn w100 mt8" data-route="certificate">View updated certificate</button>`:''}</div></div>`;
  }

  function renderJurisdictions(){
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Launch controls</div><h1>Jurisdiction & API readiness</h1><p>Global registration does not equal global investment permission. Investment and resale are enabled only after jurisdiction-specific approval gates.</p></div><span class="badge warn">Planning framework — not legal advice</span></div>
      <div class="juris-grid">${JURISDICTIONS.map(j=>`<div class="juris-card"><div class="flex between center"><h3>${j.name}</h3><span class="badge ${j.class}">${j.status}</span></div><p>${j.access}</p><div class="juris-meta"><div><span>Regulatory engagement</span><b>${j.regulator}</b></div><div><span>Likely API/control needs</span><b>${j.api}</b></div></div></div>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="section-head"><div><h2>Integration boundary</h2><p>The technical core is shared; the adapters and rule sets change by investor jurisdiction.</p></div></div><div class="flow">${[['Investor','Country / residency detected'],['Rules engine','Approved / interest-only / blocked'],['Identity','Jurisdiction-specific KYC & AML'],['Payments','Approved bank / PSP / FX route'],['Ownership','Token + certificate if permitted'],['Resale','Marketplace enabled property-by-property']].map((x,i)=>`<div class="flow-step"><div class="num">${i+1}</div><h4>${x[0]}</h4><p>${x[1]}</p></div>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="notice warn mt20"><b>External dependency limitation:</b> regulator responses, legal opinions, banking/payment onboarding, KYC provider availability and government/property-registry API access can affect production scope and timing. Some authorities may require manual verification where no production API is available.</div>`;
  }

  function renderReview(){
    const items=[
      ['journey','Buyer purchase journey','Discover → account/MFA → KYC/AML → invest → payment → token issuance → certificate → portfolio.'],
