      ['certificate','Ownership certificate','Live record + printable evidence, verification status and version history.'],
      ['marketplace','Closed resale marketplace','Persistent listings/buying interest; monthly/quarterly matching; partial fills; no liquidity guarantee.'],
      ['settlement','Settlement synchronization','Funds + compliance before token transfer; ownership, portfolio and certificate update together.'],
      ['jurisdiction','Jurisdiction gating','Approved / interest-only / restricted launch states and country-specific integrations.'],
      ['admin','Admin operations','Seller applications, property onboarding, approvals, KYC review, payments, issuance and marketplace controls.'],
      ['features','Client feature matrix','One testing page linking every agreed feature and phase.']
    ];
    return `<div class="page-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">Client testing</div><h1>Prototype review & sign-off notes</h1><p>Use this page to record scope feedback while testing. Feedback is stored only in this browser.</p></div><span class="badge info">No server upload</span></div><div class="review-grid"><div class="review-list">${items.map(x=>`<label class="review-item"><input type="checkbox" data-review="${x[0]}" ${state.review.items[x[0]]?'checked':''}><span><b>${x[1]}</b><span>${x[2]}</span></span></label>`).join('')}</div><aside class="feedback-box"><h3 style="margin-top:0">Client notes</h3><textarea id="reviewNotes" placeholder="Record changes, questions or approval notes...">${state.review.notes||''}</textarea><div class="flex gap8 mt12"><button class="primary-btn" id="exportReview">Export feedback</button><button class="ghost-btn" id="saveReview">Save</button></div><div class="divider"></div><div class="tiny muted">Checked items: ${Object.values(state.review.items).filter(Boolean).length} / ${items.length}</div></aside></div>`;
  }

  function bindRoute(r){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-demo-doc]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>toast(`${b.dataset.demoDoc}: prototype preview only — production document supplied by legal/property operations.`)));
    if(r.path==='home'){
      document.getElementById('startNewInvestor')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.kycStatus='Not verified';state.investStep=1;state.termsAccepted=false;save();routeTo('onboarding');});
      document.getElementById('startSellerJourney')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.role='seller';save();routeTo('seller-dashboard');});
      document.getElementById('enterVerifiedDemo')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.role='buyer';state.kycStatus='Approved';state.jurisdiction='GB';save();routeTo('portfolio');});
    }
    if(r.path==='onboarding'){
      document.getElementById('jcountry')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{state.jurisdiction=e.target.value;state.kycStatus='Not verified';save();render();});
      document.getElementById('runKyc')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const j=currentJurisdiction(); if(j.status==='Approved'){state.kycStatus='Approved';toast('Demo KYC/AML approved');} else if(j.status==='Interest only'){state.kycStatus='Interest only';toast('Buyer may register interest; investment remains disabled');} else {state.kycStatus='Restricted';toast('Investment disabled for this demo jurisdiction');} save();render();});
    }
    if(r.path==='seller-register') bindSellerRegistration();
    if(r.path==='seller-dashboard') document.getElementById('sellerNewApp')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.seller.status='Not registered';state.seller.step=1;state.seller.kybStatus='Not started';state.seller.docsReady=false;state.seller.applicationId=null;save();routeTo('seller-register');});
    if(r.path==='support') document.getElementById('submitSupport')?.addEventListener('click',submitSupportCase);
    if(r.path==='invest') bindInvest();
    if(r.path==='certificate') document.getElementById('printCert')?.addEventListener('click',()=>window.print());
    if(r.path==='verify') document.getElementById('verifyCert')?.addEventListener('click',verifyCertificate);
    if(r.path==='sell') document.getElementById('publishSell')?.addEventListener('click',publishSell);
    if(r.path==='buy') document.getElementById('publishBuy')?.addEventListener('click',publishBuy);
    if(r.path==='matching') document.getElementById('runMatching')?.addEventListener('click',runMatching);
    if(r.path==='settlement') document.getElementById('advanceSettlement')?.addEventListener('click',()=>advanceSettlement(r.id));
    if(r.path==='admin-property') document.getElementById('advanceProperty')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.admin.propertyApproval=Math.min(100,state.admin.propertyApproval+7);save();toast('Prototype property approval advanced');render();});
    if(r.path==='review') bindReview();
  }


  function saveSellerVisibleFields(){
    const s=state.seller;
    const val=id=>document.getElementById(id)?.value;
    if(val('sellerType')) s.profile.sellerType=val('sellerType');
    if(val('sellerCompany')!==undefined) s.profile.company=val('sellerCompany')||'';
    if(val('sellerName')) s.profile.name=val('sellerName');
    if(val('sellerEmail')) s.profile.email=val('sellerEmail');
    if(val('sellerMobile')) s.profile.mobile=val('sellerMobile');
    if(val('sellerJurisdiction')) s.profile.jurisdiction=val('sellerJurisdiction');
    if(val('sellerPropertyName')) s.property.name=val('sellerPropertyName');
    if(val('sellerPropertyCity')) s.property.city=val('sellerPropertyCity');
    if(val('sellerPropertyAddress')) s.property.address=val('sellerPropertyAddress');
    if(val('sellerPropertyType')) s.property.type=val('sellerPropertyType');
    if(val('sellerPropertyValue')) s.property.estimatedValue=Number(val('sellerPropertyValue'))||0;
    if(val('sellerTitleStatus')) s.property.titleStatus=val('sellerTitleStatus');
    if(val('sellerTargetPercent')) s.property.targetPercent=Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Number(val('sellerTargetPercent'))||1));
    if(val('sellerIncomeModel')) s.property.incomeModel=val('sellerIncomeModel');
  }

  function bindSellerRegistration(){
    document.getElementById('sellerBack')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{saveSellerVisibleFields();state.seller.step=Math.max(1,state.seller.step-1);save();render();});
    document.getElementById('sellerNext')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{saveSellerVisibleFields();if(state.seller.step===1&&!document.getElementById('sellerConsent')?.checked){toast('Please confirm due-diligence consent');return;}state.seller.step=Math.min(5,state.seller.step+1);save();render();});
    document.getElementById('sellerVerify')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.seller.kybStatus='Approved';save();toast('Demo seller KYC/KYB approved');render();});
    document.getElementById('sellerDocs')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{saveSellerVisibleFields();state.seller.docsReady=true;save();toast('Demo evidence marked ready');render();});
    document.getElementById('sellerSubmit')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!document.getElementById('sellerDeclare')?.checked){toast('Please confirm the seller declaration');return;}saveSellerVisibleFields();state.seller.status='Submitted';state.seller.applicationId='PROP-2026-0017';state.role='seller';save();toast('Property submitted for due diligence');routeTo('seller-dashboard');});
  }

  function submitSupportCase(){
    const category=document.getElementById('supportCategory')?.value||'General'; const message=(document.getElementById('supportMessage')?.value||'').trim();
    if(message.length<5){toast('Please add a short message');return;}
    state.supportCases.push({id:`SUP-${String(state.supportCases.length+1).padStart(4,'0')}`,category,message,date:todayLabel,status:'Open'});save();toast('Support case created');render();
  }

  function bindInvest(){
    document.getElementById('investmentAmount')?.addEventListener('input',e=>{state.investAmount=Math.max(0,Number(e.target.value)||0);save();});
    document.getElementById('investNext1')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const p=prop(state.selectedProperty); if(state.investAmount<p.minInvestment){toast(`Minimum prototype investment is ${money(p.minInvestment)}`);return;} state.investStep=2;save();render();});
    document.getElementById('termsAccepted')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{state.termsAccepted=e.target.checked;save();render();});
    document.getElementById('investNext2')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!state.termsAccepted)return;state.investStep=3;save();render();});
    document.getElementById('investBack1')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.investStep=1;save();render();});
    document.getElementById('investBack2')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.investStep=2;save();render();});
    document.getElementById('paymentMethod')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{state.paymentMethod=e.target.value;save();});
    document.getElementById('simulatePayment')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      state.paymentStatus='Reconciled'; state.issued=true; state.investStep=4;
      const p=prop(state.selectedProperty), units=Math.floor(state.investAmount/p.tokenPrice); let h=hasHolding(p.id);
      if(h){h.units+=units;h.income+=0;}else {h={propertyId:p.id,units,avgPrice:p.tokenPrice,currentPrice:p.tokenPrice*1.03,income:0,cert:'',certVersion:0,status:'Active'};state.holdings.push(h);}
      const oldCert=state.certificateHistory.find(c=>c.status==='Active'&&c.propertyId===p.id); if(oldCert) oldCert.status='Superseded';
      const nextVersion=(oldCert?.version||0)+1; const newCert=`OH-2026-${String(900+state.certificateHistory.length).padStart(5,'0')}`;
      state.certificateHistory.push({id:newCert,propertyId:p.id,units:h.units,version:nextVersion,status:'Active',issued:todayLabel}); h.cert=newCert; h.certVersion=nextVersion;
      save();toast('Demo payment reconciled and ownership issued');render();
    });
  }

  function verifyCertificate(){
    const id=document.getElementById('certLookup').value.trim(); const c=state.certificateHistory.find(x=>x.id.toLowerCase()===id.toLowerCase()); const out=document.getElementById('verifyResult');
    if(!c){out.innerHTML='<h3>Verification result</h3><div class="notice danger"><b>Not found.</b> This certificate number is not present in the prototype register.</div>';return;}
    out.innerHTML=`<h3>Verification result</h3><div class="notice ${c.status==='Active'?'good':'warn'}"><b>${c.status}</b> · ${c.id}</div><div class="info-grid mt16"><div class="info-item"><small>Property</small><strong>${prop(c.propertyId).name}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Version</small><strong>${c.version}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Units at issue</small><strong>${num(c.units)}</strong></div><div class="info-item"><small>Issued</small><strong>${c.issued}</strong></div></div>`;
  }

  function publishSell(){
    const p=prop(parseRoute().id), h=hasHolding(p.id); const units=Math.floor(Number(document.getElementById('sellUnits').value)), price=Number(document.getElementById('sellPrice').value);
    if(!units||units<1||units>h.units){toast('Enter a valid unit quantity');return;} if(!price||price<=0){toast('Enter a valid asking price');return;}
    state.sellOrders.push({id:`S-U${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,propertyId:p.id,units,price,created:'18 Sep 2026 13:05',status:'Open',userOwned:true}); save(); toast('Sell listing published to the closed marketplace'); routeTo('marketplace');
  }
  function publishBuy(){
    const p=prop(parseRoute().id), units=Math.floor(Number(document.getElementById('buyUnits').value)), price=Number(document.getElementById('buyPrice').value);
    if(!units||units<1||!price||price<=0){toast('Enter valid quantity and bid price');return;}
    state.buyOrders.push({id:`B-U${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,propertyId:p.id,units,price,created:'18 Sep 2026 13:08',status:'Open',userOwned:true}); save(); toast('Buying interest registered'); routeTo('marketplace');
  }
  function runMatching(){
    const matches=computeMatches(); if(!matches.length){toast('No compatible orders');return;}
    matches.forEach((m,i)=>{const id=`STL-${String(state.settlements.length+i+1).padStart(4,'0')}`;state.settlements.push({...m,id,step:1,status:'Pending'}); const ask=[...state.marketAsks,...state.sellOrders].find(o=>o.id===m.askId); const bid=state.buyOrders.find(o=>o.id===m.bidId); if(ask){if(ask.units>m.units){ask.units-=m.units;ask.status='Open';}else ask.status='Matched';} if(bid){if(bid.units>m.units){bid.units-=m.units;bid.status='Open';}else bid.status='Matched';}}); save(); toast(`${matches.length} demo settlement candidate(s) created`); routeTo(`settlement/${state.settlements[state.settlements.length-1].id}`);
  }
  function advanceSettlement(id){
    const s=state.settlements.find(x=>x.id===id)||state.settlements[0]; if(!s)return;
    s.step++;
    if(s.step>=7 && s.status!=='Completed'){
      s.status='Completed';
      if(s.userSeller){const h=hasHolding(s.propertyId); if(h) h.units=Math.max(0,h.units-s.units); const active=state.certificateHistory.find(c=>c.status==='Active'&&c.propertyId===s.propertyId); if(active) active.status='Superseded'; const newUnits=h?h.units:0; const ver=(active?.version||1)+1; const certId=`OH-2026-${String(845+ver).padStart(5,'0')}`; state.certificateHistory.push({id:certId,propertyId:s.propertyId,units:newUnits,version:ver,status:'Active',issued:'30 Sep 2026'}); if(h){h.cert=certId;h.certVersion=ver;}}
      if(s.userBuyer){let h=hasHolding(s.propertyId); if(h) h.units+=s.units; else state.holdings.push({propertyId:s.propertyId,units:s.units,avgPrice:s.price,currentPrice:s.price,income:0,cert:`OH-2026-00911`,certVersion:1,status:'Active'});}
      toast('Settlement completed: ownership and certificate records synchronized');
    }
    save();render();
  }

  function bindReview(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-review]').forEach(c=>c.addEventListener('change',e=>{state.review.items[e.target.dataset.review]=e.target.checked;save();render();}));
    document.getElementById('saveReview')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.review.notes=document.getElementById('reviewNotes').value;save();toast('Client review notes saved locally');});
    document.getElementById('exportReview')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.review.notes=document.getElementById('reviewNotes').value;save();const text=`Oblix / OneHomes Prototype Feedback\nDate: ${todayLabel}\n\nScope checks:\n${Object.entries(state.review.items).map(([k,v])=>`${v?'[x]':'[ ]'} ${k}`).join('\n')}\n\nNotes:\n${state.review.notes||'(none)'}`;const blob=new Blob([text],{type:'text/plain'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='OneHomes_Digital_Prototype_Feedback.txt';a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(url);toast('Feedback file exported');});
  }

  window.addEventListener('hashchange',render);
  render();
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
